capabilities: add a data-tag-name attribute to top-level preview divs
enable contextual typography styling via CSS
disambiguation: Not a styling plugin itself; it only adds attributes and does not add any styles.
extras: README explicitly notes the plugin adds no styles itself; only a before/after code sample is shown.
problem: Obsidian's preview mode offers no element-level hook for applying different typography styles based on a block's tag name.
summary: Development-oriented plugin that adds a data-tag-name attribute to preview divs so CSS can style typography per heading or context.
